geometry_mode: Single mesh object; original direct campus-coordinate library convention retained.

design.interior: Schematic only: basement chapter room; first-floor entry/common areas; upper bedroom/study zones. Inspired by KKG archival descriptions (1937/1959/2014), not a current floorplan.
design.textures: Procedural node materials with noise-driven color variation and bump. No external textures.
